title: Coins Galore
description: Adds Coins for currency and trading.
body:
## Features
This is a currency mod that adds different types of coins for trading with other players.
This mod also includes a villager profession that trades coins for emeralds and vice versa.
This also adds new advancements as well as new blocks and the villager profession block in the Coin Block.
## Crafting recipes
To make a hammer place an iron ingot above a stick in a crafting grid.
To make a coin place a hammer and a copper ingot in a crafting grid.
To make a iron coin place coins around a hammer in a crafting table.
To make Gold, Diamond, and Netherite do the same as the iron but using the last coin. To make a gold coin you need iron coins, ect, ect.
To make coin block just do a 3x3 of the teir of coin you want to be a block.
